metadata.title: Earnings Calendar and Analysis for This Week (August 31-September 4)

content.text:
When you buy through links on our articles, Future and its syndication partners may earn a commission.
Below is a weekly earnings calendar of the most important upcoming quarterly reports scheduled to be released by publicly traded companies. However, we have also provided expanded previews and recaps for select companies that are reporting earnings throughout the week.
Please check back often. This earnings calendar is updated regularly.
(Editor's note: Earnings dates in tables are tentative. However, companies featured in "Earnings Spotlights" have officially announced their earnings dates.)
Earnings calendar highlights
Monday (8/31)
There are no noteworthy earnings reports scheduled for release after the market closes on Monday, August 31.
Tuesday (9/1)
Wednesday (9/2)
Earnings calendar preview: Broadcom
Broadcom (AVGO) is one of several tech stocks on the earnings calendar, with the chipmaker slated to disclose its fiscal third-quarter results after Wednesday's close.
AVGO got a halo lift last Thursday from Nvidia's (NVDA) blowout earnings, though it remains roughly 7% lower year to date.
Looking for more timely stock market news to help gauge the health of your portfolio? Sign up for Closing Bell, our free newsletter that's delivered straight to your inbox at the close of each trading day.
But Wall Street remains positive for a longer-term rebound. In addition to a consensus Strong Buy recommendation from the 49 analysts following Broadcom who are tracked by S&P Global Market Intelligence, their $525.97 average price target represents implied upside of more than 40% to current levels.
As for Broadcom's fiscal Q3 print, analysts expect earnings of $3.24 per share, up 91.7% year over year (YoY), on revenue of $29.4 billion (+84.9% YoY).
"We generally expect slightly better results and guidance, driven primarily by upside in AI networking and Software," says Susquehanna analyst Christopher Rolland, who has a Positive (Buy) rating on AVGO. "While broader demand for AI semis remains 'insatiable' and bookings continue to far outpace revenue, we note that tightening supply constraints on advanced process nodes may limit upside on AI processors in the near term."
Thursday (9/3)
Earnings calendar preview: Lululemon Athletica
Lululemon Athletica (LULU) represents consumer discretionary stocks on the earnings calendar, with the athletic apparel retailer's fiscal second-quarter results due out after Thursday's close.
Wall Street is calling for LULU to report earnings of $1.80 per share (-41.9% YoY) on revenue of $2.5 billion, unchanged from the year-ago period.
"We recently downgraded LULU to Sell as we believe current headwinds will likely prove to be more structural than what is being underwritten by the Street," says Truist Securities analyst Joseph Civello. "While the current management team is confident in an inflection in full-priced sales in the second half, we believe that will likely prove ambitious due to momentum remaining limited."
Civello adds that with little visibility into turnaround efforts, especially with slowing growth in China, and incoming CEO Heidi O'Neill's strategic efforts, risks for fiscal 2026 are skewed to the downside.
Friday (9/4)
Reporting schedules are provided by Briefing.com and company websites. Earnings estimate data provided by Refinitiv, an LSEG business, via Yahoo! Finance, and S&P Global Market Intelligence via Briefing.com.
